227)rdzas ni/khye'u gtsang mas chu mig shar bltas nas chu blangs pa la/ba dmar pa dang dkar po'i 'o ma/bzang drugaklu sman btab/rlon btsa' la/skyes pa gtsang mas gnam

tei:div.tei:p: 227) rdzas ni/ khye'u gtsang mas chu mig shar bltas nas chu blangs pa la/ ba dmar pa dang dkar po'i 'o ma/ bzang drug klu sman btab/ rlon btsa' la/ skyes pa gtsang mas gnam ma mthong ba'i sa dang chu chen bye ma la/ khyi 'brug glang gsum/ rus pa/ kha sha/ gna' rwa/ skyer pa'i bar shun/ re lcag mu zi/ mtshur nag ba bla/ zam shing*/ rtsa khu byug dge 'dun mang po'i chab bsil pa/ bu mo gtsang ma'i dri chu/ gla rtsi/ ra thug rgya bo'i khrag rnams bsre/ ༈ mdos rdzas/ zangs phye/ lcags phye/ btsa' phye/ phye tshig bya spu/ 'bru nag rigs/ snye nag snye stong*/ 'bu long*/ 'bu kog chang skyur/ sbang ma/ ra phag bya rnams kyi sha khrag rus pa/ shing nag sna tshogs bcas/ ༈ ra lpags la= khram ris thig gi mong bris la/ dbyug pa'i rtser phyar/ dar dmar pos brgyan/ ༈ 'ur rdo 'phen rgyu rdo grangs mang*/ ༈ dad (?)dus/ byi phag lo pas zhwa gos dkar po gyon/ chu gtor khyi 'brug glang lug lo pas bye ma bran/ mi gos dmar gyon pas ra lpags sngon du khyer/ btsa' thams cad ra'i g.yang gzhi cod pan 'di ma thim zhig ces brjod/ de rjes mdos khyir/ mi rta 228) go mtshon can gyis ki bswo cha sgra/ btsa' 'dre phud do rjod/ sngags pas 'ur rdo 'phen/ ༈ mnan chas/ ling ga chu dug btsa' khu/ li di'i spu ngang pa/ kyung ka phug ron rnams kyi spu dang khrag shing bal dmar ser/ lcags btsa' can/ rdo dregs dmar po bcas/ ri bong pags pas thums/ ra spu/ khyi spu rnams kyis dkri/ g.yag ru'i nang du bcug satshtsha dkar pos mnan/ de steng tho dkor brtsig zhing rnams kyi mtha' bskor/ tho dkar po rdo nag po'i tog can grangs ched bya/
